column3: The Hebrew “and processions to the right” is elliptical; NKJV renders “One went to the right hand,” and the Dung Gate is “the Refuse Gate.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the one going in front” is rendered “went the opposite way.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּשַׁעַר הַמַּטָּרָה (“Gate of the Guard”) is rendered “the Gate of the Prison.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the singers made heard” is rendered “sang loudly,” and Izrahiah is spelled “Jezrahiah.”
Close to the Hebrew; “who were standing” is rendered “who ministered.”
